description: This file defines the OutOfRangeException class, a custom exception used in the Apache Commons Math library to signal that a value is outside of the specified range. It extends MathIllegalNumberException and includes details about the bounds and the offending value.

classes.name: OutOfRangeException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating a value is out of the specified range. Contains references to lower and upper bounds and provides constructors for creating instances with contextual information.

methods.name: OutOfRangeException(Number wrong, Number lo, Number hi)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a default localized message and the provided wrong value, lower bound, and upper bound.

methods.name: OutOfRangeException(Localizable specific, Number wrong, Number lo, Number hi)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific localized message, the wrong value, and the range bounds.

methods.name: getLo
methods.description: Returns the lower bound associated with the exception.

methods.name: getHi
methods.description: Returns the upper bound associated with the exception.
